summary: Expiry is at hand and no new evidence can be produced, so this points at the retained draft without claiming new work. The audit is complete on its own terms: all necessary gaps closed, no open questions in the controller's list, and six threads recorded. The snapshot is unmodified upstream etcd-raft v3.7.0 at commit b867cf13. Two sourced defects are asserted with retained executions. Read-index retry growth: ReadOnlySafe admission is per request and context-blind, so same-context retries accumulate one queued or unconfirmed entry each with no library-side bound and no reclamation while the process lives, and the queue is later released as a burst of one admission plus one heartbeat per entry; receipts cover the queued path and retention across deposition, the admitted path, the release burst, a CheckQuorum control that closes the growth window at step-down while retaining state, a byte measurement of caller payload (262144 bytes for 64 requests with 4 KiB contexts in 64 distinct buffers), and a real isolated-leader network run where 32 requests gave confirmed zero and 64 heartbeats, correcting the amplification to one heartbeat per peer per retry. Configuration change: with a joint configuration and no change pending unapplied, an empty ConfChangeV2 whose transition is not Auto passes propose-time validation as an EntryConfChangeV2, commits in a real three-node network, and panics the application in ApplyConfChange with config is already joint, because validation reads an empty change set as leave-joint while the apply path also requires the Auto transition, with the Auto form as the working control. The remaining threads are explained or refuted with explicit boundaries: readOnly ack validation out of contract, queued read requests kept fresh across term changes, the StateSnapshot repair duty with both exits measured, and proposer eligibility of removed members resting with the caller under the documented MsgProp contract.
